name: Dudes Battlegrounds
creator: Fantastic! Games
redeem: Launch Dudes Battlegrounds and wait for the lobby to finish loading.
Open the Shop from the icon near the top right of the screen (a blue diamond in the current version).
Select the CODES tab inside the Shop window.
Type or paste the code into the Code... box and press REDEEM.
notes:
Dudes Battlegrounds is a superhero fighting game from the verified group Fantastic! Games, with a character roster inspired by the TV series The Boys. You pick a hero, drop into a shared arena, and fight other players using punches, blocks, dashes, and four character abilities, then build up to an ultimate. The game is still labelled as a beta, and new characters and mastery skins arrive through regular numbered updates.

Codes usually give Vialites, the premium currency used on characters and cosmetics, along with Tokens and Fortune Wheel spins. The developers release one code per update, named after the update number, plus codes for like, favorite, and group-member milestones, and they announce them on Discord and in the game description.

faq.q: What are Vialites used for in Dudes Battlegrounds?
faq.a: Vialites are the premium currency in Dudes Battlegrounds, spent on characters and cosmetics. Codes usually give 500 to 1,000 Vialites. Other codes give update Tokens or Fortune Wheel spins instead.

faq.q: How are new Dudes Battlegrounds codes named?
faq.a: Fantastic! Games usually releases one code per numbered update, named after the update number. For example, UPD72 gives 72 Tokens. Extra codes come out when the game hits like, favorite and group-member milestones, such as 190KLIKES, 2MFAVS and 2MGROUP. Current codes are also listed on the CODES line of the Roblox game description.

tips: Learn to block with F and dash with Q. Blocking at the right time stops combos, and a well-timed dash gets you out of trouble.
If you get ragdolled, press Q to cancel it and escape. Saving this for when you are knocked down can turn a lost fight around.
Save your special move on the G key until an enemy is low or cannot dodge. Using it too early gives them time to get away.
If a server is laggy, the game page suggests making a free private server. It is also a good place to practice combos.
useRewards: 2MFAVS and 190KLIKES give 1,800 Vialites together, the premium currency for characters and cosmetics, so redeem both and pick a character you enjoy playing. UPD72 gives Tokens, and update codes are named after the update number, so look for a new one after each update. The single Fortune Wheel spin from 2MGROUP can be used any time.
